themeDescription: Leaking pouches, crushed goods & missing items

challenges.title: Milk Pouch Leak Ruined Fresh Bakery Items
challenges.shortDescription: Immediately process photographic proof, arrange swift replacement dispatch, and credit wallet for ruined groceries.
challenges.mission: Inspect customer upload photo of leaking milk pouch, apologize for packing negligence, and initiate instant replacement tote.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I opened your kraft delivery bag and it was a complete disaster! The 1-litre milk pouch burst and soaked all my artisanal burger buns, croissants, and organic eggs! Everything is a soggy white mess!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: immediate replacement of intact items and apology for poor packing

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Demands to know why heavy liquids were packed on top of bakery.
hiddenObjectives: Issue instant full refund for contaminated items
Order immediate 10-minute re-dispatch of bakery goods in separate pouch

challenges.title: Missing 1kg Basmati Rice from Sealed Delivery
challenges.shortDescription: Verify dark store weight logs, apologize for the picking error, and initiate instant replacement or refund.
challenges.mission: Check tote packing scan logs, confirm 1 line item unfulfilled, and credit account without interrogating customer.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I ordered 5 items. The invoice in the bag lists 1kg Daawat Basmati Rice for ₹210, but the bag only contains tomatoes, onions, and curd! The rice is completely missing! I cannot cook lunch without rice!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: States facts clearly and expects zero friction resolution.
hiddenObjectives: Apologize for picker packing slip omission
Dispatch standalone rider with rice pouch within 10 minutes
possibleSolutions: Instant UPI refund if customer prefers

challenges.title: Glass Olive Oil Bottle Smashed in Kraft Bag
challenges.shortDescription: Instruct safe disposal without injury, verify safety precautions, and issue immediate priority reimbursement.
challenges.mission: Prioritize physical safety, advise careful disposal, instantly refund the damaged bottle and affected bag contents.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Careful! The rider handed me the brown bag and glass shards literally poked through the bottom! Your 500ml extra virgin olive oil bottle completely shattered inside and oil is all over my floor!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: avoiding cuts, cleaning the oil mess, getting refund

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Warns about hazardous glass shards and stained entryway.
hiddenObjectives: Advise customer not to reach inside bag bare-handed
Process instant 100% refund for bottle + spoiled items
Flag warehouse packing lead for lack of bubble-sleeve protection
possibleSolutions: Full refund + deep cleaning courtesy credit

challenges.title: Crushed Egg Carton Smudged with Raw Yolk
challenges.shortDescription: Resolve an egg carton transit damage complaint with instant partial refund and packing feedback log.
challenges.mission: Verify egg carton damage, process swift per-unit reimbursement, and ensure customer satisfaction.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I opened my 12-pack of organic brown eggs and six of them are crushed into yellow pulp! Raw yolk is all over my yogurt tubs and apples. Don't your riders use dividers in their delivery boxes?

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Shows photo of broken egg shells.
hiddenObjectives: Validate egg damage via photo snapshot
Offer immediate fresh replacement carton with priority rider
Credit refund balance to user account
